extDescription.message: Lets Tangu see the tabs you have open and work in its own tab group in the background, without taking over the page you are on.

statusOffline.message: Tangu is not running, or the connect code is out of date

statusBadCode.message: The connect code was rejected. Copy it again from Tangu.

codePlaceholder.message: Paste the code from Tangu → Settings → Browser

codeHelp.message: In Tangu, open Settings → Browser → Chrome extension and copy the connect code. You only need to do this once.

codeInvalid.message: That doesn't look like a Tangu connect code.

groupHint.message: Tabs Tangu opens are kept in the orange “Tangu” tab group.
